tool_schemas.name: get-token-info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches Pump.fun token details by internal token_id or by on-chain mint_address and returns the stored token record including identifiers and any known on-chain metadata. If both parameters are provided, they must refer to the same token or the request fails. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither token_id nor mint_address is provided or either value is malformed, NOT_FOUND if no token matches the supplied identifier, and CONFLICT if both identifiers are provided but resolve to different tokens.

token_id.description: Internal token id (tok_pump_... ULID) to fetch info for.

mint_address.description: Solana mint address to look up token info for.

tool_schemas.name: create-token
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Pump.fun token using the specified creator_account_id and returns the created token record, including the internal token_id, mint address once available, status, and any recorded transaction signature(s) for on-chain creation. The request is idempotent by request_id: reusing the same request_id returns the previously created result, while reusing it with different input fields is rejected. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields (including non-integer decimals or invalid metadata_uri format), NOT_FOUND if creator_account_id does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the account is not in an allowed status (e.g., disabled/compromised/missing_key), and CONFLICT if the request_id is already bound to a different create-token payload.

request_id.description: Client-provided idempotency key for the create-token request.

creator_account_id.description: Creator account id (acct_sol_... ULID) used to create the token.

name.description: Token name to create on Pump.fun.

symbol.description: Token symbol/ticker to create on Pump.fun.

decimals.description: Token decimals to use for the mint.

metadata_uri.description: Metadata URI for the token (e.g., Arweave/IPFS/HTTPS).

tool_schemas.name: buy-token
tool_schemas.description: Creates a persisted buy intent for the given account_id and token_id and returns the trade record with its current status and any known on-chain execution data (e.g., submitted/confirmed transaction signature when available). The request is idempotent by request_id: повтор submissions with the same request_id return the same trade, but the service rejects attempts to change the parameters under an existing request_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, non-positive or non-integer amount_in_raw, or slippage_bps outside allowed bounds, NOT_FOUND if the account_id or token_id does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the account cannot trade due to status, and CONFLICT if request_id is reused with different fields or if the existing trade is in a terminal state that cannot accept a conflicting update.

request_id.description: Client-provided idempotency key for the buy request.

account_id.description: Account id (acct_sol_... ULID) placing the buy.

amount_in_raw.description: Input amount in raw units (string integer), typically lamports when buying with SOL.

slippage_bps.description: Allowed slippage in basis points for the swap.

tool_schemas.name: sell-token
tool_schemas.description: Creates a persisted sell intent for the given account_id and token_id and returns the trade record with its current status and any known on-chain execution data (e.g., submitted/confirmed transaction signature when available). The request is idempotent by request_id: repeating the same request returns the original trade, while reusing request_id with different amount/slippage/account/token is rejected. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, non-positive or non-integer amount_in_raw, or slippage_bps outside allowed bounds, NOT_FOUND if the account_id or token_id does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the account cannot trade due to status, and CONFLICT if request_id is reused with different fields or if the existing trade is in a terminal state that cannot accept a conflicting update.

request_id.description: Client-provided idempotency key for the sell request.

account_id.description: Account id (acct_sol_... ULID) placing the sell.

amount_in_raw.description: Input amount in raw units (string integer), typically token base units when selling.

slippage_bps.description: Allowed slippage in basis points for the swap.

tool_schemas.name: list-accounts
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally managed Solana accounts, optionally filtered by status and key_source, and returns a single page of account records. Results are paged using cursor/limit; the response includes a next cursor when more results are available, and omitting cursor returns the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid status/key_source value, a non-positive limit, or an invalid cursor.

limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-account-balance
tool_schemas.description: Returns the account’s SOL balance and SPL token balances, optionally filtered by asset_type and (for SPL) mint_address, as a paged list of balance rows. Results are paged using cursor/limit; the response includes a next cursor when more results are available, and omitting cursor returns the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed, if mint_address is provided without asset_type=SPL or is invalid, or if limit/cursor are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the account is not in an allowed status to query (e.g., missing_key/compromised when restricted).

account_id.description: Account id (acct_sol_... ULID) to fetch balances for.

asset_type.description: Optional filter to return only SOL or only SPL balances.

mint_address.description: Optional SPL mint address filter when asset_type is SPL.

limit.description: Maximum number of balance rows to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-account
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single locally managed Solana account by account_id and returns the stored account record including public_key, key_source, status, and timestamps. If the referenced key file is missing on disk, the service updates the account to status='missing_key' and last_seen_at to now before returning. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if no account exists for the id.

tool_schemas.name: update-account
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a locally managed Solana account and/or drives allowed lifecycle status transitions. Returns the updated account record. Refuses disallowed status transitions (e.g., disabled->compromised), attempts to edit immutable identifiers (public_key/key_ref), or updates to accounts that cannot be found.

status.description: New account status. Must be a valid transition from the current status.

tool_schemas.name: list-tokens
tool_schemas.description: Lists token records known to the service, optionally filtered by creator_account_id, status, or mint_address, and returns a single page of results. Results are paged using cursor/limit; the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters, a non-positive limit, or an invalid cursor.

creator_account_id.description: Filter tokens by creator account id (acct_sol_... ULID).

mint_address.description: Filter tokens by exact mint address.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: update-token
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a token record and/or drives allowed lifecycle status transitions (e.g., draft->creating, live->archived, failed->creating). Returns the updated token record. Refuses disallowed transitions, attempts to modify immutable identifiers (mint_address/pump_market_address once set), or updates to tokens that cannot be found.

status.description: New token status. Must be a valid transition from the current status.

tool_schemas.name: list-trades
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted trade intents and execution tracking records, optionally filtered by account_id, token_id, side, status, or request_id, and returns a single page of results. Results are paged using cursor/limit; the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters, a non-positive limit, or an invalid cursor.

account_id.description: Filter trades by account id (acct_sol_... ULID).

token_id.description: Filter trades by token id (tok_pump_... ULID).

request_id.description: Filter trades by client-provided idempotency key.

limit.description: Maximum number of trades to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-auth-session
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity as seen by the service, including its subject, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for this API key. Refuses requests with missing/invalid credentials.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate this request (as provided to the service).
